description: Buy the full personalized comic (digital PDF, emailed) once get_comic_status reports preview_ready. Pass slug, ownerKey and the email the PDF should go to. Returns a checkoutUrl for the user to pay in their own browser — this tool never sees card details. This tool buys the digital PDF only; printed copies can be ordered on the website. Comics are sold to buyers in the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand.
name: purchase_comic
title: Buy the full comic
